Exam Date & Time: 04-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  Essentials of Cyber Security [CSE-3232]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Describe the Cybersecurity Framework Model with its core functions.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the incident response policy phases.                                          (2)  
  C)      Distinguish between the different versions of X.509 Digital Certificates standard and  
  further discuss about the X.509 Authentication Service.                               (5)  
  
2)           Demonstrate the working of LSB technique of Steganography in detail.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      List and justify the elements of group policy objects.                                (5)  
3)           Identify and discuss in detail the confidentiality security model for military  
  applications.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Identify the components of the operational model of computer security.                (2)  
  C)      Assume you have received a ping request from another system in the network. In this  
  scenario, construct and explain the flow diagram of the packets with respect to the (5)  
  different chains of tables of iptables tool.  
  
4)           Prepare a list of questionaries to be answered in case of physical security.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Demonstrate the working of Digest authentication for the negotiation of credentials  
  across the web.                                                                       (4)  
  
  C)      Explain the different types of firewalls based on the Layers OSI /TCPIP model.        (2)  
5)           Robo solutions has a collaboration project with Pranav technologies in which both  
  employees must have access to network services of both organizations. Moreover,  
  the data transmitted in this process must be encrypted to provide confidentiality.    (5)  
  A)      Examine and analyze the scenario to propose to them the best technique/protocol  
  with proper justification and explanation to serve the purpose.  
  
  B)      Demonstrate with an example the working of different default chains of FILTER         (5)
